feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 October 2026 10:20pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 26 October 2026 at 10:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales, risk of severe gales for a time.


##Synopsis##

A very deep area of low pressure will track north of Scotland, sweeping associated frontal systems across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southwest 7 or gale 8, occasionally severe gale 9 in places early tonight. Veering southwest 7 or gale 8 later in night, decreasing west or southwest 6 or 7 later tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, building rough or very rough for a time tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Weather##

Rain for a time tonight, then isolated showers tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain at first. Becoming generally good later tonight.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 6 or 7, decreasing 5 or 6 on Wednesday morning, backing southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good.
